templates.title: BookOrbit
templates.name: bookorbit
templates.description: BookOrbit is a self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics. It syncs progress and highlights across the web reader, Kobo, and KOReader, with metadata lookup, reading stats, OPDS, and multi-user OIDC support.
templates.note: Your self-hosted reading space for books, audiobooks, and comics

env.name: APP_URL
env.label: APP_URL
env.description: Public URL used by emails and Kobo endpoints - replace [YOUR_CASAOS_LAN_IP] with your server IP (required)

env.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.label: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
env.description: PostgreSQL password - CHANGE THIS IN PRODUCTION (required)

env.name: JWT_SECRET
env.label: JWT_SECRET
env.description: Secret used to sign login tokens - CHANGE THIS IN PRODUCTION (required)

env.name: SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN
env.label: SETUP_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN
env.description: One-time token required to complete the setup wizard (required)

env.name: PUID
env.label: PUID
env.description: Runtime UID for files written to app data folders - match your books folder owner on NAS (optional)

env.name: PGID
env.label: PGID
env.description: Runtime GID for files written to app data folders - match your books folder owner on NAS (optional)

env.name: LIBRARY_BROWSE_ROOT
env.label: LIBRARY_BROWSE_ROOT
env.description: Container folder where the library picker starts instead of / (optional)

env.name: BOOK_DOCK_PATH
env.label: BOOK_DOCK_PATH
env.description: Container path for the automated ingestion drop folder (optional)
